subject: MAP & dataset rotation: RetailAI evaluation kit and usage ledger
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@retailai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & trial datasets — next steps for RetailAI pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers look promising for our storefront ranking use case. Wed like to move to a short evaluation: exchange a small set of labeled testcases + a prompt pack so your team can run the same acceptance evals we use internally.

High-level asks from our side:
- Wed like a 90-day sandbox window to evaluate on Redwood Dedicated (ephemeral tokens).
- Data retention: delete copies after completion unless otherwise agreed.
- Usage limit: non-production evaluation only, no downstream training or redistribution.

I attached a zipped sample of the first batch of testcases (RetailAI_testcases_v1.zip) and a short README. Can you propose a mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed close timeline? If it helps, our legal team can pre-clear a short MOU with the usage constraints above.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Sr. ML Product Manager, RetailAI
Attachment: RetailAI_testcases_v1.zip (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@retailai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & trial datasets — next steps for RetailAI pilot

Thanks Elena d appreciate the test bundle. Quick reply with a proposed MAP and timeline so we have something concrete to iterate on: 

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Acceptance artifacts exchange (this week): RetailAI provides testcases + prompt pack (we received RetailAI_testcases_v1.zip).
2) Technical onboarding (days 1-3): Redwood provides sandbox credentials, a short runbook (sample-access-instructions.txt), and a small evaluation pipeline snapshot.
3) Run evaluation (days 4-21): Redwood runs agreed evals and shares tokenized logs + result dashboard.
4) Review & close (days 22-30): joint review meeting; if both sides accept, we discuss potential Dedicated reservation for pilot.

Usage constraints we propose to include in the MAP:
- Evaluation-only use; no model retraining or derivative dataset creation.
- Sandbox access expires automatically after 90 days unless extended in writing.
- Audit log export available on request; Redwood will not retain raw testcases beyond agreed retention window.

Ive attached a short "maplet" that lists the milestones and a sample acceptance checklist (redwood-maplet-v1.pdf). If your legal team wants to start parallel review, share their contact and well loop in our contract ops.

Next steps: can we target kickoff on Monday (Nov 23)? If so, Ill spin up the sandbox and send credentials.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-maplet-v1.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: redlines for MAP and sandbox controls

Team -- quick internal note before we finalize the map with RetailAI. Key technical/ops redlines I want captured in the MAP: 

- Sandboxed infra: Dedicated trial will run in an isolated tenant with token scoping and no export of KV caches.
- Artifacts: RetailAI testcases will be stored encrypted at rest; we will only mount them to ephemeral containers that are torn down at termination.
- Logging: We will provide aggregated pass/fail metrics and per-case scores; raw traces with PII redaction can be exported under NDA.
- Throttles: cap evaluation throughput to 20 qps to ensure no noisy neighbor issues in the pool.

Also, confirm whether we should require an explicit tech-contact from RetailAI (name/email) for troubleshooting. If they want an extended retention window we'll need a signed MPA and SOC2 evidence sharing checklist.

If everyone agrees, Marissa please share the updated maplet in Drive and Ill inline the tech appendix.

-Karthik
Sr. Eng Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@retailai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailAI Legal <legal@retailai.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & dataset rotation — acceptance and minor edit

Marissa, thanks for the clear plan and the maplet. RetailAI is happy to proceed with the proposed cadence. Two small edits from our legal side:

1) Retention: we can accept the 90-day sandbox, but request a 30-day grace period after which Redwood will notify us before deletion (email notice + confirmation).
2) Use limitation: add explicit text that RetailAI authorizes Redwood to run evaluation-only batch inference and aggregated logging; no unredacted export of raw testcases without a separate agreement.

Tech contact: sending along our SRE lead, Priya Menon <priya.menon@retailai.com>, who will be on point for test-run troubleshooting.

Wed be ready for kickoff Monday (Nov 29) if that works on your end; otherwise we can do Nov 30. Ill also route a short MOU to the DocuSign link you shared for signature.

Cheers,
Elena Rossi
Sr. ML Product Manager, RetailAI
Attachment: none
